title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 14: the elders with idols in their heart, the three righteous men, and the four judgments on Jerusalem.

questions.text: Who came and sat before the prophet?
questions.explanation: Some of the elders of Israel came to him and sat before him.

answers.text: Some of the elders of Israel

questions.text: What had these men taken into their heart?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says these men have taken their idols into their heart and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face.

questions.text: What is the house of Israel told to do in verse 6?
questions.explanation: They are told to return and turn themselves from their idols, and to turn their faces away from all their abominations.

answers.text: Return and turn from their idols
Flee to the land of Egypt
Build up the wall of the city

questions.text: What would Yahweh make of the man who takes his idols into his heart?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will set his face against that man and make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and cut him off from among his people.

answers.text: An astonishment, a sign and a proverb

questions.text: What would Yahweh do to a prophet who is deceived and speaks a word?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will stretch out his hand on that prophet and destroy him from among his people Israel.

answers.text: Destroy him from among his people
Take away his power to speak

questions.text: How great is the prophet's iniquity, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: They will bear their iniquity, and the iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him.

answers.text: Twice that of the one who seeks him
As great as the iniquity of the one who seeks him
Half that of the one who seeks him
Greater than that of the princes

questions.text: Which three men are named as righteous in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in the land, they would deliver only their own souls.

questions.text: Whom would those three men deliver by their righteousness?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness, and neither sons nor daughters.

questions.text: What are the four severe judgments Yahweh says he will send on Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh speaks of his four severe judgments on Jerusalem: the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence.

answers.text: Fire, flood, hailstones and thick darkness
The sword, the famine, the evil animals and the pestilence
War, exile, drought and swarms of locusts
The sword, fire, hailstones and thirst

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will be left in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He says a remnant will be left in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters, and they will come out to the prophet.

answers.text: A remnant of sons and daughters
Only the priests of the temple
Only the walls of the city
